series_monthly_sources.policy_rate_pct: BIS central bank policy rates (monthly, end of period);  Central bank policy rates - North Macedonia - Monthly - End of period
series_monthly_sources.fx_per_usd: BIS exchange rates, monthly average, local currency per USD;  Exchange rates against USD North Macedonia - Denar - Monthly - Average of observations through period
series_monthly_sources.reer_broad_real: BIS real effective exchange rate, broad basket (64 economies), 2020=100
series_monthly_sources.cpi_yoy_pct: IMF CPI database, all items, y/y % change, monthly
series_monthly_sources.reserves_ex_gold_usd_bn: IMF International Liquidity, reserves excluding gold (FX, SDRs, IMF position), USD bn, monthly
series_monthly_sources.gold_reserves_usd_bn: IMF International Liquidity, gold at national valuation, USD bn, monthly
series_monthly_sources.reer_imf_2010: IMF real effective exchange rate, CPI-based, 2010=100, monthly
series_monthly_sources.ctot_net_export_gdp_idx: IMF commodity terms of trade, net export price index weighted by net exports to GDP, rolling weights, Jun-2012=100, monthly
series_monthly_sources.gross_reserves_usd_bn: IMF International Liquidity: reserves excluding gold plus gold at national valuation, USD bn, monthly
series_monthly_sources.official_reserve_assets_usd_bn: IMF reserve template: official reserve assets, approximate market value, USD bn
series_monthly_sources.predetermined_drains_usd_bn: IMF reserve template: predetermined short-term net drains on FX assets within one year (loans, securities, deposits, forwards and swaps), USD bn, negative = outflow
series_monthly_sources.contingent_drains_usd_bn: IMF reserve template: contingent short-term net drains on FX assets, USD bn
series_monthly_sources.reserves_net_of_drains_usd_bn: Official reserve assets plus predetermined short-term net drains (IMF reserve template), USD bn: reserves net of what is already committed to leave within a year

fsi_sources.car_pct: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIC), Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets, %, deposit takers, quarterly
fsi_sources.tier1_pct: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIC), Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets, %, deposit takers, quarterly
fsi_sources.npl_pct: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIC), Nonperforming loans to total gross loans, %, deposit takers, quarterly
fsi_sources.provisions_to_npl_pct: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIC), Provisions to nonperforming loans, %, deposit takers, quarterly
fsi_sources.roa_pct: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIC), Return on assets, %, deposit takers, quarterly
fsi_sources.roe_pct: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIC), Return on equity, %, deposit takers, quarterly
fsi_sources.fx_open_position_to_capital_pct: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIC), Net open position in foreign exchange to capital, %, deposit takers, quarterly

series_quarterly_sources.goods_balance_usd_bn: IMF Balance of Payments (BPM6), quarterly; Goods balance, net, USD bn
series_quarterly_sources.services_balance_usd_bn: IMF Balance of Payments (BPM6), quarterly; Services balance, net, USD bn
series_quarterly_sources.primary_income_usd_bn: IMF Balance of Payments (BPM6), quarterly; Primary income, net, USD bn
series_quarterly_sources.secondary_income_usd_bn: IMF Balance of Payments (BPM6), quarterly; Secondary income (incl. remittances), net, USD bn
